documents.lede: Reports and notes for the team: written by you, or by agnts from tickets, commits, pull requests and repositories.
documents.empty: No documents yet. Create one, or ask agnts to write a report.
documents.daysLeft: {n, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}
documents.newSub: Write it yourself, or have agnts write it from what the workspace knows.
documents.title: Title
documents.kindHelp_report: The approved report of a plan, analysis, bug or review ticket, rewritten for its readers.
documents.kindHelp_tickets: Chosen tickets, or tickets by state and period: their state, dates, reports and commits.
documents.kindHelp_commits: Commits of repositories in a period, with the tickets they are linked to.
documents.kindHelp_pulls: Pull requests with their descriptions and diffs: a review digest or release notes.
documents.kindHelp_repo: agnts reads the whole repository in a sandbox: architecture, quality, tests, risks.
documents.statesHelp: None ticked: every state. The period limits by last update.
documents.author: Author
documents.prNumbersHelp: Optional, in one repository. Empty: by state and period.
documents.templateHint_status: Done, in progress, blocked, risks, next steps
documents.templateHint_pr_review: Each change, its risk, what to look at
documents.templateHint_blank: The shape your instruction asks for
documents.instructionPlaceholder: For the client, no technical detail. Focus on risks.
documents.notFound: This document does not exist, or you cannot open it.
documents.regenerateSub: agnts writes it again from the same source. The result is a new version; nothing is lost.
documents.deleteConfirm: Move “{title}” to the trash? It can be restored for 30 days.
documents.queued: Waiting for agnts to start writing…
documents.writingNow: agnts is writing this document. It appears here when it is done.
documents.overwrote: agnts wrote a new version over edits by {name} from {when}.
documents.conflictHelp: The document is at version {n} now. Keep your text on top of it, or start again from theirs.
documents.pdfFailed: The PDF could not be made. Try again in a few minutes, or download Markdown.
documents.pdfSlow: The PDF is taking long. Try again in a minute.
documents.linkedByAgntsHint: agnts linked the tickets the document was made from
documents.badKey: That is not a ticket number.
documents.diffHelp: What changed from version {n} to the current text: removed lines are struck through, added ones green.
documents.sameText: The text is the same as now.
documents.privateHelp: Only you, the people below and the workspace owner.
documents.publicHelp: Anyone with the link can read and download it, without signing in. It shows no names or tickets.
documents.publicOff: Public documents are turned off in this workspace’s Settings.
documents.secretsTitle: This text looks like it holds secrets.
documents.secretsHelp: Remove them from these lines, save, then make the document public.
documents.resetHelp: The old link stops working at once.
documents.workspaceAccessHelp: At least this for every member. Viewers can only read.
documents.ownerNote: The workspace owner can always open this document.
documents.transferConfirm: Make {name} the owner? You keep edit access.
documents.ticketSub: Documents about this ticket that you can open
documents.fromReport: Make a document from the report
documents.publicGone: The document was made private or deleted, or its link was changed.
documents.settingHelp: Let document owners share a public link that anyone can open. Off: every public link of this workspace stops working at once.
documents.newForTicket: Linked to {number}. Write it yourself, or have agnts write it.
